title.narrative: Building resilience through improved nutrition in suburban food systems, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan

description.narrative: Overall Objective The social and economic resilience and nutritional status of suburban communities in Khyber and Peshawar districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province are strengthened.Project Goal: 6,000 households in suburban communities in Khyber and Peshawar districts have improved their nutritional situation.

Project aims to directly target 6000 households (approximately 48,000 people, i.e., - at an average of 8 members) in 7 village councils of Tehsil Shahalam in District Peshawar and 10 village councils of Tehsil Bara in Khyber district. In total, the project aims to target a population of 48,000 out of 135,034 people in 17 village councils of both districts.

The project titled "Building resilience through improved nutrition in a suburban food systems, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan" is being implemented in the suburab localities of district Peshawar and Khyber. According to NNS-2018, 40.0% of children under five in the province of KP are stunted, 15.0% suffer from emaciation, 23.1% are underweight, and 12.9% are overweight. A total of 35.5% of the population in KP is food insecure in 2019, according to the Comprehensive Food Security and Livelihood Assessment (CFSLA) Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES). Increasing urbanization aggravates precarious conditions in suburban spaces. Both districts, has severely affected by ‘war on terror’ with subsequent military operations and internal displacement of population. Both districts especially Peshawar has experienced rapid urbanization in the last decade. the overall objective is "The social and economic resilience and nutritional status of suburban communities in Khyber and Peshawar districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province are strengthened.
